purpose: Find independent vertical observations rather than count another rendering of existing model profiles as new evidence.

new_source.title: Year-round vertically resolved observations of upper ocean hydrography and biogeochemistry in the Atlantic Water inflow north of Svalbard
new_source.review_basis: Publisher search-index abstract, introduction, results excerpt and data-availability statement; no full-method verification, retained article bytes, raw-data download or figure digitization.

published_context.source_named_flow: Svalbard Branch of Atlantic Water inflow
published_context.metric: Published water-mass occurrence within the sampled upper ocean; not paired velocity-current boundaries.

interpretation: This is useful seasonal observational context. The deepest reported water-mass depth coincides with the profiler's approximate sampling limit; it cannot establish a finite lower boundary or total thickness.
Do not subtract these depths to manufacture current thickness, use mixed-layer depth as a current bottom, or infer a seasonal thickness range from year-round sampling alone.

The source names a downstream branch. Do not automatically assign its observations to the whole West Spitsbergen Current, the distinct Spitsbergen Atlantic catalogue entry, or the broad Norwegian Current.
Archive metadata ends in June 2023 whereas the article describes July 2023. Exact analysed dates require verification before pairing or seasonal statistics.
Hydrography at Y2-1 and velocity at Y1-1 are different moorings. Proximity does not establish collocated profiles, a common water parcel, or interchangeable vertical and temporal coordinates.

archive_metadata_review.declared_content: Raw hydrography and current records, with upward-looking ADCPs at nominal 50 m and 301 m; instrument depths are not current boundaries.
archive_metadata_review.inventory_request_outcome: Web tool cache miss; no inventory or binary bytes retained.

archive_metadata_review.declared_content: Raw hydrography and profiling-winch records; upper segment recovered in 2023, lower segment recovered in 2024. Metadata names a processed version, which was not requested.
archive_metadata_review.inventory_request_outcome: Web tool cache miss; no inventory or binary bytes retained.

other_leads.note: Selected-core width and instrument reach do not independently establish a current bottom. Original retained paper must not be downloaded again.

other_leads.access_outcome: Direct DOI open failed with a non-retryable redirect to inaccessible Elsevier linkinghub. Subsequent search returned publisher-index text; no alternate direct fetch or raw archive request was made.
other_leads.qualitative_evidence: The publisher-index results describe limited coastal-water influence at a deeper sensor. This is potentially useful local water-mass evidence, but no universal current bottom follows from it.
other_leads.admission: None. Do not retry the failed target, obtain a mirror, or infer exact boundary coordinates from sensor placement.

next_evidence_requirement: Prioritize an independent accessible publication or previously retained document that reports a source-defined regional layer thickness or paired boundaries. For native profiles, qualify identity, license, exact dates, vertical coordinates, QC, size and prospective combined case budget before acquisition. Preserve instrument-limit censoring, branch ownership and unknowns. Do not reopen any closed acquisition above.
